column1: # The page each author's id in examples/typst-xref-places.qmd names (M119).
# Derived BY HAND from that source, under the ORACLE RULE at the head of
# tests/run-tests.sh, and never copied from a render. Read by
# tests/typstlabels.py links. One row per id, in the order page 12 links to
# them. The pages come from the source's explicit page breaks: page 1 holds
# the contents and the two lists, and each break starts the next page.
#   id-ash    the heading on page 2
#   id-oak    the body text on page 2
#   id-beech  the caption of the picture with an id, page 3
#   id-cork   the caption of the table with an id, page 4
#   id-date   the caption of the picture with no id, page 5
#   id-elm    the alt text of the image on page 6
#   id-gum    the same alt text, page 6
#   id-hazel  the footnote on page 7, printed at the foot of that page
#   id-ivy    the callout title written as its attribute, page 8
#   id-jade   the callout title written as its first heading, page 9
#   id-kelp   the callout body, page 10
#   id-lark   the alt text of the image in the caption on page 11
#   id-nut    the alt text of the image in another image's alt text, page 6
